intent.description: What the change does, in a few words the author reads in the app, such as "Bars rise one by one".

operations.description: Batch compatible edits as one Undo step, or send one standalone operation. Every number keeps the millionth.

revision.description: From presentations.get or slides.get; stale when a slide it changes has changed, or anything, for a presentation-wide change.

composition.description: Makes the slide a composition, a reusable scene other slides place; `size`, `controls` and `name` belong to it alone.

controls.description: A composition's controls; only with `composition: true`.

file.description: The files of the pictures its layout gives it, by object id: an image or a video in the media or generated folder.

name.description: A composition's name; only with `composition: true`.

size.description: A composition's own size; only with `composition: true`.

slideId.description: Minted when omitted; the batch may place slides against it, and later proposals change its objects.

text.description: The words of the texts, tables and shapes its layout gives it, by object id, as Markdown.

afterStepId.description: Insert after this step; null means first, omitted means last.

stepIds.description: The new steps' ids, one per step, so a later `updateStep` or `tween` of the same batch, or the next proposal, addresses them without reading them back; minted when omitted.

time.description: Nonnegative seconds, kept to the microsecond.

exponential-scale.description: Whether the move to this keyframe scales at an even rate, as After Effects' Exponential Scale does.

interpolation.description: Interpolation into this keyframe, from the preceding keyframe or the step's start.

end.description: When it would have ended, in step seconds, at or after the keyframe's time; it does not extend the step.

interrupted.description: The longer move this keyframe interrupts: up to this keyframe, the motion follows that move's curve.

oscillate.description: An oscillation added from this keyframe on, its wave named as the file names it.

path.description: On a point keyframe, `frame.xy`, `translation.xy` or `position.xyz`: the move into it bends along this path.

start.description: When the move into this keyframe begins, in step seconds; until then the value before it holds. Absent, at the keyframe before.

time.description: Nonnegative seconds, kept to the microsecond.

value.description: Null clears an optional property; its current text-style/default then applies.

keyframes.description: By id, one set for the step's keyframes and cues: an id it holds is replaced whole, and null deletes it.

loop-from.description: Step seconds where the loop while waiting begins; null removes the loop.

loops.description: Each named curve's loop whole, its word and the keyframe it loops from; null takes it off. No keyframe's edit changes it.

min-duration.description: The least seconds the step lasts; a later keyframe, cue or entering paragraph extends it.

repeat.description: Play the step this many times; null plays once.

start.description: Play with the step before it or after it ends, within its click; null waits for a click.

AgentEnterEffect.description: The Animate tab's effects, each by its name, as an object's `enter` and `exit` name theirs in the file.

time.description: Seconds within the step, at least 0; 0 at Start.

AgentMoment.description: A moment in a slide's motion, as a read, a render and an edit name it alike: Start, its `stepId` null and its `time` 0, or seconds within a step, clamped to its effective duration.

rotation.description: How far it is turned, in degrees clockwise.

AgentObjectTransformSource.description: A transform as the file names an audio icon's position and a line's ends, an end on an object's `last-position` among them, and a framed object's frame and a line's ends where they are drawn, `drawnFrame`, `drawnStart` and `drawnEnd`, which the file's frame and ends are not for a growing text or an object auto layout places.

AgentRevision.description: An opaque revision from presentations.get, slides.get or an accept, naming the presentation as you last saw it; the one value that guards a change.

AgentSpaceTransform.description: A 3D object's move: any parts of its position, its whole rotation in its rotation mode and any parts of a model's or a light's scale. The parts it leaves out stay as they are.

afterSlideId.description: The slide of the destination section they go right after; null puts them first.

firstSlideId.description: The slide the new section starts at, which moves into it with the slides after it in its section; null adds an empty section at the end.

anyOf.description: The Animate tab's and the timeline's timing edits, each as the app makes it.

AgentStepEditSource.description: A timing edit with its fields in the file's words: a click as the file leaves a step's `start` out, a keyframe's `exponential-scale` and an oscillation's `wave-shape`.

AgentStepId.description: A step's stable id, as `slides.get` lists it.

AgentTransformFrame.description: The frame a transform gives an object, where it is drawn, as slides.get's `drawnFrames` gives it: every side, but a table's height only where the edit sizes the table. A text box that grows to its words may leave its height out, as a height sizes nothing there; a width its words give it sizes nothing either.

exponential-scale.description: On a `scale`, `scale.x`, `scale.y`, `scale.z`, or `crop.scale` change: reach `to` at one rate of zoom, as a camera push does, or evenly from or to 0 or across it, where no rate reaches; absent, it changes evenly.

AgentTweenChangeSource.description: A tween's change in the file's words.

last-position.description: Where the end was when last drawn; a live target takes precedence.

AttachedLineEndSource.description: A line's end on an object as the file spells it.

min.description: Number controls: the range a binding maps from; both or neither.

anyOf.description: A number control. With min and max, min is below max and the default is from min to max.

start.description: When the move into this keyframe begins, in step seconds; until then the value before it holds. Absent, at the keyframe before.

PresentationAnimationKeyframeSource.description: A keyframe as the file spells it: a move's `end` and `exponential-scale`, and a fill as the object spells its fill.

frequency.description: Cycles a second, as After Effects' wiggle() frequency sets it; a noise wanders at that rate.

phase.description: Degrees into the cycle at the keyframe.

seed.description: Which noise a noise wave draws, as Motion's Random Seed picks one; the same seed always draws the same.

PresentationAnimationOscillationSource.description: An oscillation as the file spells it: its wave is `wave-shape`.

orient.description: Turn the object to face along the path as it moves.

PresentationAnimationPath.description: A path in chord space: the start is (0, 0), the end (1, 0), and one unit across is a chord length right of travel.

PresentationAnimationPoint.description: A point keyframe's value: a frame's or a translation's x and y, or a 3D position's x, y and z.

PresentationAnimationTargetSource.description: A curve's target as the file names it: its object's id is `object`.

anyOf.description: What a keyframe holds: a number, a flag, a color or a role, a fill, lengths, a shadow, a 3D object's whole orientation, or a point.

PresentationAnimationValueSource.description: A value as the file spells it: a fill as `accent` or a gradient whose stops name their colors. The scene's `animationValueSchemas` gives the range of each parameter the slide's objects offer, by kind of object. Core refuses a value outside its parameter's range and names both.

anyOf.description: Omission inherits; None explicitly disables the presentation's transition, and still starts on a click or by itself, a cut that moves on as an automatic transition does.

PresentationPropertyChangeSource.description: One of the presentation's own properties and its value, as the file keys and spells it; null takes it away.

PresentationReplicaArrangement.description: A replica's copies in a grid a gap apart, or a ring a radius from the selection's center, as groups and repeaters.

PresentationRotation3d.description: How a 3D object turns, in degrees about the 3D space's axes (x right, y up, z toward the viewer), in Cinema 4D's HPB order: heading about y, then pitch about its own x, then bank about its own z, three.js's YXZ Euler. A positive z turns it counterclockwise on the slide, a positive x tilts its top toward the viewer and a positive y brings its left side forward. With the rotation mode "quaternion" it is a quaternion instead, `w` and `x`, `y`, `z` in the same axes, each part divided by its length as written and then kept to the millionth, a keyframe's too, and its keyframes turn it whole, the shorter way round. A model's Blender quaternion (w, x, y, z), exported to glTF with +Y up, is (w, x, z, −y) here.

PresentationStepCueSource.description: What a cue starts, as the file spells it: its `type`, and a clip's `clip-trim`, `blend-in` and `clip-scale`.

min-duration.description: The least seconds the step lasts; left out or 0, it lasts as long as what it holds.

repeat.description: Play the step this many times before it completes; omitted plays once.

start.description: Plays without a click of its own: with the step before it, or after that step ends, as PowerPoint's With Previous and After Previous do. Its times then count from that start. On the first step it plays after the transition. Omitted, the step waits for a click.

PresentationStepInputSource.description: A step as a proposal spells it; its curves may be left out, as a step that only waits or cues has none.

PresentationTableFrame.description: A table's frame as the files hold it: where it stands. Its width is its columns' and its height its rows', never stored.

before.description: The words as read; a text changed since refuses the replacement.

PresentationTextReplacementTarget.description: Null objectId addresses the slide's speaker notes.
